query: I want to track my workouts and health metrics. What's the best smartwatch for fitness tracking?
atoms: perspective: iPhone user focused on general health and lifestyle tracking
perspective: Serious endurance athlete needing precise training data
plausible_answers: Answer A (Apple Watch Default): Get the Apple Watch Series 9 if you're on iPhone — the best health sensor accuracy, ECG, and tightest app ecosystem make it the default choice for general health and fitness tracking.

Answer B (Garmin for Serious Athletes): Choose a Garmin Forerunner or Fenix if you're a serious runner, cyclist, or triathlete — multi-band GPS, 2-week battery, and advanced training metrics are unmatched by Apple or Samsung for performance sports.

Answer C (Fitbit for Sleep and Wellness): Get a Fitbit if your priority is long-term health trend monitoring and sleep quality — its sleep tracking and wellness insights are more detailed than Apple Watch at a lower price point, ideal for general health over athletic performance.
baseline_answer: Answer A (Apple Watch Default): Get the Apple Watch Series 9 if you're on iPhone — the best health sensor accuracy, ECG, and tightest app ecosystem make it the default choice for general health and fitness tracking.
